description:
Move event matching in library unit tests onto the body view, so the envelope change touches only definitions and constructors.

## Background

Unit-test modules under `crates/jit/src` match `Event::<Variant>` and build variants with explicit `id` and `timestamp` fields. The heaviest are `domain/types.rs`, `repository_state/mutation.rs`, `storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs` (11 lines), and the test modules of `commands/profile.rs` and `commands/issue.rs` (8 each). Further sites sit in the test modules of `storage/json.rs` (`:1833,2273,2285`), `commands/gate.rs` (`:2197,2323`), `commands/mod.rs` (`:3980,3989`), `commands/worktree.rs` (`:805`), `domain/store_divergence.rs` (`:171`) and `domain/queries.rs` (`:504-521`), among the other files in the footprint. Production code already matches through `Event::body()`, and `test_utils` offers a helper that stamps an id and a timestamp onto a body.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No unit-test pattern under `crates/jit/src` matches `Event::<Variant>`; each matches `EventBody::<Variant>` on the body view.
- [hard] REQ-02: In unit tests, no pattern binds `id` or `timestamp` from a variant, and no code outside `domain/types.rs` constructs a variant with those fields; constructions use draft constructors or the `test_utils` helper that stamps both.
- [hard] REQ-03: Test assertions are otherwise unchanged.
title: Unit tests match events through the body view
